AGENDA

  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, October 19, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on October 19, 2023, at 10:09 a.m.
  •  Present: Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Commissioners Vidor, Yank, Zadorian
  •  Absent: Chairperson Viar
  •  The Agenda for the October 19, 2023, Regular Meeting was posted on October 11, 2023, on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before
  motion is proposed.
  Minutes of the September 21, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.

  Moved:  Commissioner Yank
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Vice Chairperson Tufenkian, Commissioners Vidor, Yank, Zadorian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Chairperson Viar
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program Coordinator

  • Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

  b. Recognition of outgoing Director of Library, Arts & Culture – Dr. Gary Shaffer

  •  The Commission expressed their pleasure in working with Dr Shaffer and thanked him for all his
  work with the Arts and Culture Commission. Dr. Shaffer thanked the Commission and Staff.
  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked Dr. Shaffer for all he’s done and stated it has been an honor working
  alongside him on the many public art initiatives within Glendale.

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  • Public Comment by Wisam Koharyan who would like to showcase his artwork related to
  environmental and climate change on a larger scale with the assistance of the Commission to
  display to a greater audience; The Commission thanked the speaker for his presentation.

  1
 5. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2023 – 2024 Work Plan Progress

  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an brief update on the 2023-2024 Work Plan Progress with a PowerPoint.
  i.  Mural Ordinance – Update:
  • Staff is working the City Attorney’s Office on drafting the final Mural Ordinance that will be
  scheduled for initial review by the Commission at an upcoming Regular Meeting of the Arts
  and Culture Commission. Staff is working with Beautify Earth to host a Community Input
  Meeting on the mural ordinance scheduled for January/February 2024, and will keep the
  Commission apprised on progress.
  ii.  Verdugo Park South Facility Building Mural: Update
  • The artist Erin Miller Wray completed the mural installation “Color Everywhere” for the
  Verdugo Park South Facility Building. This is the first major public art commission on
  behalf of the Arts and Culture Commission as part of the partnership with LeBasse
  Projects to commission and curate public artworks for the City of Glendale. Staff shared
  photos of the completed mural during the Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting
  on October 19, 2023.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones thanked LeBasse Projects and Glendale Parks Department for their
  work on the project.
  iii.  Beyond the Box Utility Box Mural Program – Update:
  • Artists will be painting utility boxes this weekend from October 20 – 22, 2023 as part of this
  year’s Beyond the Box program. The finalists were shared during last month’s meeting
  and will be painting utility boxes across Glendale this weekend.

6. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
  • Commissioner Zadorian asked what the next steps would be for the Oral
  Communications speaker, Wisam Koharyan. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones highly recommended
  Mr. Koharyan apply to the upcoming LeBasse RFQ for consideration. Commissioner
  Zadorian also asked if it would be possible for staff to host a community input meeting
  with stakeholders, arts organizations and others to share about public art updates. Ms.
  Fukutomi-Jones shared that the Commission may discuss this as an opportunity during
  an upcoming meeting.
  • Commissioner Vidor asked about accessibility of RFQ (request for qualifications) and
  Call for Artists (CFA) to make sure the Commission is reaching out to everyone. Ms.
  Fukutomi-Jones stated that the Creative Crosswalks – Request for Proposals RFP is
  currently translated in five languages (English, Armenian, Spanish, Korean and Tagalog)
  and stated that this is a good example moving forward of making RFQs and calls for
  artists CFA available and accessible. Commissioner Vidor also inquired about an art
  project that was rejected by City Council and would like to understand the issues why it
  was rejected; Dr. Gary Shaffer gave a response.
  • The Commission thanked Dr.Gary Shaffer for his service with the Glendale Arts and
  Culture Commission.

7. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS – NONE

8. ADJOURNMENT – 10:49 A.M.

The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, November 16, 2023, at
10:00 AM at City Council Chambers.
